plus_start_when_confirmed: Start Plus when the payment confirms
plus_start_when_confirmed_consent: I agree that {} is taken from my balance when the payment confirms, then every {} days while auto-renew is on.
plus_disclosure_crypto: Next you'll choose a coin. Send the exact amount shown, every decimal; it may be slightly more than the dollar amount.
plus_disclosure_credit: Your balance is credited in US dollars only once the payment fully confirms. Coming back to the app doesn't confirm it.
plus_disclosure_no_auto_charge: Your crypto wallet is never charged automatically. Renewals use your FlixQuest balance.
plus_choose_coin_body: Pay {} from any crypto wallet or exchange. You'll see the exact amount next.
plus_email_receipt_body: NOWPayments sends it to your account's email address.
plus_send_rest_body: {} of {} arrived. Send the remaining {} to the same address.
plus_qr_label: QR code of the {} deposit address
plus_network_warning: Send only {} on {}. Another coin or network can be lost.
plus_memo_warning: Include the memo, or the payment can't be matched to you.
plus_tag_warning: Include the destination tag, or the payment can't be matched to you.
plus_exchange_fee_warning: Send the exact amount, every decimal. If your exchange takes its fee from what you send, add the fee on top.
plus_quote_expired: The quoted amount ran out. Haven't sent yet? Get the current amount first.
plus_open_wallet_failed: No wallet app opened the link. Copy the address instead.
plus_waiting_live: Waiting for your payment. This updates by itself.
plus_confirming_body: Your {} is confirming on {}. This can take a few minutes, and you can leave this screen.
plus_tv_phone_send_body: Waiting for {} on {}. Send it from your phone; this screen updates by itself.
plus_tv_phone_rest_body: Part of the payment arrived. Send the remaining {} from your phone to finish.
plus_error_coin_too_small: This amount is below the minimum for that coin. Choose another coin or add more.
plus_error_coin_unavailable: That coin isn't available right now. Choose another.
plus_error_checkout_limit: Too many coins were tried for this top-up. Start a new one.
plus_error_topup_closed: This top-up is closed. Start a new one.
plus_payment_keep_checking: You can leave this screen. The payment carries on, and your balance updates once it confirms.
plus_payment_reference_hint: Keep this reference in case you need help with this payment.
plus_payment_received_plus: Your balance is topped up and Plus is on until {}.
plus_payment_partial_body: Part of the payment arrived, but not enough to add to your balance. Send the rest to the same address to finish.
plus_payment_nothing_charged: Nothing was added to or taken from your balance. You can start a new payment.
plus_payment_reversed_body: NOWPayments reversed this payment, so its credit was removed from your balance.
plus_payment_preparing_body: Hold on while the payment is set up.
plus_payment_still_waiting_body: Blockchain confirmations can take a while. Check again in a few minutes.
plus_history_empty: No top-ups or Plus periods yet.
plus_spotlight_body: FlixQuest Plus is {} every {} days. Pay with crypto.
plus_delete_pending: A payment is still confirming and may add credit after the account is gone.
plus_tv_sign_in_body: Plus belongs to your FlixQuest account, so it works on this TV and on your phone. Sign in, then come back here.
plus_error_offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
plus_error_insufficient_balance: Your balance doesn't cover the next Plus period. Add funds first.
plus_error_wallet_frozen: Your balance is on hold. Contact support.
plus_error_mode_conflict: Plus already renews another way on this account.
plus_error_terms_outdated: The Plus terms changed. Review and accept them again.
plus_error_unavailable: Payments aren't available right now. Try again later.
plus_error_checkout_pending: Your payment is still being prepared. Check again shortly.
plus_error_coupon_exhausted: This code has been fully used.
plus_error_discount_active: You already have a discount waiting for your next renewal.
plus_error_period_overlap: This Plus period is already paid.
plus_error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
plus_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
plus_cta_guest: Sign up and subscribe to Plus to get rid of ads
plus_cta_member: Subscribe to Plus to get rid of ads
plus_code_waiting_body: Sign up or sign in, and FlixQuest offers to redeem it straight away.
plus_tv_phone_step1: Scan this code with your phone's camera
plus_tv_phone_step2: Pick an amount and pay with crypto
plus_tv_phone_step3: This TV updates by itself once the payment confirms
plus_tv_phone_expires: The code is for this account only and renews by itself.
plus_tv_phone_paying_body: Your {} top-up is waiting for payment. This screen updates as soon as it confirms.
plus_tv_reminder_body: {} every {} days. Pay from your phone with crypto.
plus_delete_balance_lost: Deleting the account removes this balance for good.
flix_ai_limit: You have reached today’s FlixAI limit.
flix_ai_busy: Your reply is still being prepared. Wait a moment, then retry.
flix_ai_error: FlixAI could not finish that request. Please try again.
flix_ai_hint: Tell me what you feel like watching…
flix_ai_privacy: Chats are saved to your account. Messages are sent to our AI provider. Requests, including failed attempts, count toward your daily limit. Recommendations use TMDB.
flix_ai_sign_in: Sign in or create a free account to discover your next favorite with FlixAI.
flix_ai_intro: What are you in the mood for?
flix_ai_subtitle: Describe a mood, a story, or something you loved. We’ll find movies and series that fit.
flix_ai_broadened: I widened the search to similar genres to find more options.
flix_ai_no_matches: No matching titles this time. Try a broader mood, genre, or another reference title.
flix_ai_search_cta: Find movies and series by mood or conversation
flix_ai_delete_message: This conversation will be removed from your account.
tv_landing_pitch: A free account keeps your list and progress on every screen.
tv_benefit_resume: Pick up where you left off, on your phone or this TV.
tv_guest_caption: Your list stays on this TV only
tv_guest_confirm_body: As a guest, your list and watch progress stay on this TV only, and FlixQuest Plus isn't available. A free account takes a minute and works on your phone too.
tv_sign_in_subtitle: Welcome back. Your list and progress are waiting.
tv_create_account_subtitle: It's free, and your list follows you to every screen.
playlist_too_many_lists: You can keep up to {count} lists. Delete one to make another.
playlist_list_full: A list holds up to {count} titles.
playlist_edit_all_removed: Tap Done to empty this list, or Cancel to keep it as it was.
playlist_delete_message: The list goes from all your devices. The titles stay in My List and anywhere else you saved them.
playlist_empty_message: Open a movie or series and choose Lists to add it here.
playlists_empty_message: Group titles your way, like a weekend watch or a family night, or bring in a list from TMDB or IMDb.
playlist_import_tmdb_intro: Paste the link to a public TMDB list. Its movies and series come in, in the list’s own order.
playlist_import_imdb_intro: IMDb doesn’t let other apps read its lists, so they come in through IMDb’s own export file.
playlist_import_imdb_step_open: On imdb.com, open the list, your watchlist or your ratings.
playlist_import_imdb_step_export: Choose Export, then download the CSV from Your exports.
playlist_import_imdb_step_choose: Come back here and choose that file.

playlist_import_unsupported.one: {count} skipped: not a movie or series

playlist_import_truncated: Only the first {count} came in; a list holds no more.
playlist_problem_episode: An episode; lists hold movies and series
playlist_import_none_found: None of its titles could be found on TMDB.
playlist_import_sign_in: Sign in to import lists. They’re read on FlixQuest’s servers and kept with your account.
playlist_import_error_link: That isn’t a TMDB list link. It looks like themoviedb.org/list/8136.
playlist_import_error_not_found: That list isn’t on TMDB any more.
playlist_import_error_private: That list is private. Make it public on TMDB, then try again.
playlist_import_error_csv: That file isn’t an IMDb export. Export the list from IMDb and choose the CSV it gives you.
playlist_import_error_csv_empty: That export has no titles in it.
playlist_import_error_busy: Other imports are still running. Let them finish first.
playlist_import_error_offline: You’re offline. Connect, then try again.
playlist_import_error_unavailable: Importing lists isn’t available right now.
playlist_import_error_source: The list couldn’t be read right now. Try again in a little while.
tv_playlist_import_intro: Type the number from the list’s address, as in themoviedb.org/list/8136, or the whole link.
tv_playlist_import_hint: Type a list number, such as 8136, or a TMDB list link.
tv_playlist_import_imdb: IMDb lists import from FlixQuest on your phone, using IMDb’s export file.
tv_playlist_import_description: Bring in a public TMDB list by its number.
tv_playlist_new_description: Name a list, then add titles to it with Lists on their page.
tv_playlist_hold_to_manage: Hold OK to rename or delete
tv_playlists_empty_hint: You don’t have any lists yet. Make one with New list.
playlist_share_anyone: Anyone with the link can view
playlist_share_explainer: They see the list’s name, its titles and your name, and can save a copy. Only you can change it.
playlist_share_failed: Sharing couldn’t be changed right now. Try again in a moment.
playlist_shared_missing_title: This list isn’t shared any more
playlist_shared_missing_message: Its owner made it private or deleted it.
playlist_shared_failed: The list couldn’t be opened. Check your connection and try again.
playlist_save_copy_hint: The copy is yours to change; edits to this one won’t reach it.
tv_playlist_share_scan: Scan with your phone to open or send the list, or share this link.
device_limit_body: This account is already signed in on as many devices as its plan allows. Choose a device to sign out so you can sign in here.
